the leakage current mechanism in a dielectric is the key to understand and predict its reliability.

the development of a physical model that describes the reliability of MIM capacitors with Pd/SiN/Pd.

the physical mechanisms of dielectric reliability.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the leakage mechanism of the MIM capacitor is described by Poore-Frenkel condcuction mechanism, which leads to a sqrt(E) model.
the Poole–Fenkel model for current conduction in MIM capacitors leads to the sqrt(E) model of dielectric reliability.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Poole–Frelkel mechanism, leading to a sqrt(E) model, is an excellent predictor for the reliability of silicon nitride M IM capacitors.
the Poole–Freenkel conduction mechanism is responsible for the leakage current and the dielectric degradation in SiN MIM structures.
